stem.text: Substance T was analysed and found to contain 62.07% carbon, 10.34% hydrogen and 27.59% oxygen.
The infra-red spectrum of substance T is shown.

stem.alt: Infra-red spectrum of substance T: transmittance in % (0 to 100) against wavenumber in cm-1 (4000 to 500), with a broad absorption at about 3300 cm-1 and a strong absorption near 1100 cm-1.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a six-membered ring with an OH group on the upper-left carbon and an OH group on the opposite (lower-right) carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched carboxylic acid: a methyl branch drawn upward on the chain, a C=O group with the O drawn above, and an OH group at the end.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of propanone: a C=O group with the O drawn above and a methyl group on each side.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a straight zig-zag chain with an HO group at the left end and an OH group at the right end.
